messages:
alex: Pushed PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 — migration guide for SDK v2, batching example, and a small KMS snippet. CI preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/gh/2345. Marking as possibly sensitive because of the KMS example.
marie: skimmed quick — looks good overall. can you remove the inline example key in the KMS snippet? I think I spotted `api_key = \"abcd1234\"` in one place.
alex: good catch, thanks. I'll scrub that and push a new commit. also want to confirm reviewers: docs + security + legal for the KMS part.
dev-docs-bot: Lint: passed. Links check: 1 broken (internal /guides/old-kms -> 404). Preview deployed at https://preview.redwood.dev/gh/2345/build/22.
sanjay: from security: please avoid literal credential examples and replace with `KMS_PLACEHOLDER`. Also prefer referencing the KMS integration doc instead of inline code.
jia: legal here — @linda-legal can you take a quick look for any compliance wording around customer-managed keys and export controls? if not, i can queue it.
linda-legal: can do tomorrow AM. main ask: redact the sample token and add a short caveat about customer data retention in the KMS example. i'll leave comments on the PR.
alex: pushed commit 7f9a3b0 — removed the inline api key, replaced snippet with `key_placeholder = "KMS_PLACEHOLDER"`, and fixed the broken link to /guides/kms-integration. preview updated: https://preview.redwood.dev/gh/2345/build/23.
ci-bot: Docs preview build succeeded (23). Visual diff: 2 changed files. No secret scanner alerts.
marie: thanks. i'll do docs-side review after legal sign-off. quick note: can we keep the migration example short — users often copy the whole snippet. maybe collapse with a comment `# see full example in guides`.
alex: good point — collapsed the example and added a callout to the full guide. pushed commit 7f9a3c2.
linda-legal: left 3 inline comments about wording; none are blockers. approve after those small wording changes.
sanjay: security ack — no secrets and KMS wording looks safe.
marie: approved from docs once those 3 wording comments are addressed.
alex: fixed the wording comments, pushed 7f9a3d0. requesting merge window: prefer to merge tonight at 22:30 PST to avoid overlapping with the infra deployment tomorrow morning. CI is green.
sanjay: ok for security — fine to merge in that window.
linda-legal: i'll re-check after merge but fine to proceed.
marie: :thumbsup: will merge at 22:30 PST. tagging release hold and making a quick release note entry.
alex: thanks everyone. filing follow-up ticket to add a short 'redaction checklist for docs' (internal) so this pattern is simpler next time.
ci-bot: Merge queued. Auto-merge scheduled for 1943262600 (22:30 PST).
alex: closing the thread here — appreciate the quick reviews.
